operations.description: If this[4] (this+0x10) is non-zero dispatch to the audio stream buffer read path; if zero dispatch to the file size query path.
Zero-mode path: call FileSizeQueryWrapper with the handle at this+0x0 to query file size.
Return the result of FileSizeQueryWrapper for the zero-mode path.
Non-zero-mode path: call AudioStreamBufferRead(this[0], 0, 1) to read from the audio stream buffer. Call target address is absent from packet evidence.
Return the result of AudioStreamBufferRead for the non-zero-mode path.
